adminFinance.disclosureTitle: Not every figure below is measured
adminFinance.disclosureLead: These are structural zeros, not quiet months. Totals and averages computed from them carry the same caveat. Each turns live on its own flag.
adminFinance.refundsNotMeasured: Refunds: not tracked here, so this stays at ₹0. Service-request refunds are not included.
adminFinance.servicesNotCounted: Revenue excludes the services marketplace: a service order records a quote, not money received.
adminFinance.servicesQuoted: Quoted value, not money received, so it is left out of revenue.
adminFinance.arppuBasis: Across the {{count}} who paid this month.
adminFinance.mrrChartBasis: Subscription revenue booked each month. The tile above is the current run rate, which is a different question.
adminFinance.unavailableBody: The finance service did not answer, so nothing is shown rather than zeros — a ₹0 here would be indistinguishable from a platform that earned nothing. Reload to try again.
adminFinance.ledgerUnavailable: The ledger could not be loaded, so this table is empty for that reason rather than because there were no transactions.
adminFinance.ledgerTruncated: Showing {{shown}} of {{total}} transactions. Narrow the filters to see the rest.
